extracted.name: Honey soy sprouts
extracted.description: Try a new twist on sprouts. Shredding and coating them in a sticky soy and honey sauce takes them to a new level – it's sure to be a crowd-pleaser
ingredient_lines: thumb-sized piece ginger peeled and cut into small pieces
instruction_lines: Stir the honey and the soy together in a small bowl. Set aside.

Heat the oil in a wok and fry the ginger and garlic for 1 min. Add the shredded sprouts and stir-fry for 1-2 mins until wilted. Pour in the Shaoxing wine, then the honey sauce. Toss everything together. Season, drizzle with the sesame oil, scatter with sesame seeds and serve.
